Name: IF - Fishery Expansion
Author: Malacay2k11
Description:
[center][size=4][font=Arial][color=#ff7700][b]New Buildings (built by Robin)[/b][/color][/font][/size][font=Arial]
Four new buildings can be constructed on your farm after completing the [color=#e06666]Fish Tank Community Bundle![/color]

[color=#9fc5e8][b]Breed Fish Pond:[/b][/color] Place fish roe inside and wait 5 days. The quality of the hatched fish depends on your Fishing level.
[b][color=#9fc5e8]Fish Stairs:[/color][/b] A large storage and processing facility for up to 20 fish.
[color=#9fc5e8][b]Fish Trap Building:[/b][/color] A dedicated water structure. Requires both the Fish Bundle and a proven track record as a fisherman.

[b][color=#9fc5e8]???[/color]: [/b]A fourth building unlocks under different, darker circumstances, if you know where to look.[color=#999999][size=1](HINT: Just play the Story!)[/size][/color]

[size=4][color=#ff7700][b]
New Machines[/b][/color][/size]
Six machines form the backbone of your fishery. Unlock them progressively through your Fishing skill:

| Machine |    Unlocked at |

| Filleting Table | Fishing Level 2 |
| Fish Fryer | Fishing Level 3 |
| Cutter Machine | Fishing Level 4 |
| Fish Oil Press | Fishing Level 5 |
| Canning Machine | Fishing Level 7 |
| Automated Filleting Machine | Fishing Level 8 |


[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Fish Traps[/b][/size][/color]
Three tiers of deployable fish traps can be placed directly in [b][color=#dd7e6b][size=3]any body of water[/size][/color][/b] on any location, including the [color=#1e84cc][size=4][b]Beach Farm[/b][/size][/color]. They work automatically overnight and produce different results depending on the bait used.

[b][color=#a4c2f4]Small Fish Trap[/color][/b]: Available at Willy's shop (up to 3 per day)
[color=#b4a7d6][b]Trawler Fish Trap[/b][/color]: Available at Willy's shop (1 per day).
[color=#d5a6bd][b]Large Fish Trap[/b][/color]: Only available on [b]Fridays[/b] at Willy's shop.
The bait you choose determines the quality and rarity of your catch. Experiment to find out what works best.[/font]

[/center]
[center][color=#ff7700][font=Arial][size=4][b]28 New Fish[/b][/size][/font][/color][font=Arial]
A full roster of new fish across four difficulty tiers, spread across rivers, lakes, and the sea. Many follow seasonal patterns — not every fish is available year-round, and some only appear under specific conditions.
One fish stands apart from the rest. It has no season. It does not bite easily. And it requires a very specific kind of pool to obtain reliably.


[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Willy's Shop[/size][/color][/b]
Willy expands his inventory as you build a relationship with him and make progress in the valley. Beyond basic fishing supplies, he'll eventually offer machines, advanced traps, and more, but only to fishermen he trusts.[/font]
[/center]
[center][font=Arial]
